titles.page: Jobs not yet fully invoiced, leaving out draft jobs, jobs awaiting quote approval, rejected and archived jobs, and jobs with no revenue recorded. Sorted by most uninvoiced first.
titles.grossWip: Revenue of all the work on this job so far (labour, materials and adjustments) at the rates the customer is charged.
titles.invoiced: Total of this job's invoices excluding GST, draft invoices included.
titles.netWip: Gross WIP less invoiced: work done that hasn't been invoiced yet. Can be negative when a job is invoiced ahead of the work.
titles.jobCount: Number of jobs listed (archived jobs not counted).

dayCell.title: {{date}}: {{grade}}. Click to see revenue, cost and profit by job.
dayCell.weekendTitle: {{date}}: {{grade}}. Weekends are never graded: they owe no share of overhead, so any money earned on them is a bonus. Their revenue and cost still count in the month's totals. Click to see revenue, cost and profit by job.

titles.hours: Billable: hours on customer jobs marked billable. Total: all paid hours recorded that day, including shop work; unpaid time such as lunch is left out.
titles.labour: Labour profit for the day: revenue from billable hours less the wage cost of every hour worked, shop hours included.
titles.materials: Materials profit for the day: what customers are charged for stock and purchases put on jobs, less what they cost us.
titles.adjustments: Profit from manual adjustment lines added to jobs that day (revenue less cost). These can be negative.
titles.grossProfit: Labour, materials and adjustments profit added together for the day, before overhead.

monthTable.loadError: Failed to load the sales forecast.
monthTable.empty: No invoices or job revenue in these months

detail.loadError: Failed to load the month details.
detail.empty: No invoices or job revenue in this month

titles.jobFinish: For an invoiced job, the date of its first invoice this month; for an invoice not linked to a job, its date; for work not invoiced, the last date anything was recorded on the job.
titles.note: "Shop job": the shop's own job. "Multi-month": work on the job ran across more than one month. "Xero only": an invoice not linked to any job. "DocketWorks only": work this month with no invoice this month.

page.aboutBody: Compares, month by month, what Xero has invoiced with the revenue DocketWorks puts on jobs, to show work not yet invoiced and how invoicing runs. Pick a month to see the invoices and jobs behind it. Xero figures include GST; DocketWorks revenue excludes it, so a month invoiced in full shows about 15% more in Xero.
page.title: Sales Forecast Report

dayDialog.description: Revenue, cost and profit for the day, and the jobs that made it
dayDialog.noJobs: No job had revenue or cost on this day

titles.revenueLabour: Charge-out on billable hours only; shop hours and non-billable time earn no labour revenue.
titles.costLabour: Wage cost of every paid hour that day, billable or not, at wages including paid leave.
titles.adjustments: Manual adjustment lines added to jobs on this day.
titles.profitByJob: Each job's revenue less cost for this day, most profitable first. Hover a job number for its name and customer; click to open it.

material.title: Materials — {{month}}
material.description: Stock and purchases charged to jobs

titles.together: Everything on jobs that isn't labour: materials plus adjustments, added together.
titles.nonLabourShare: Share of the month's total revenue that came from materials and adjustments rather than labour.

profitDialog.title: Profit — {{month}}
profitDialog.description: Revenue less cost is gross profit; less overhead to date is net profit

titles.lessOverhead: The daily gross profit target (the business's running costs per weekday) times the weekdays gone so far this month, today included.
titles.averageGrossProfit: Month's gross profit, weekends included, divided by every weekday in the month, including ones still to come.
titles.dailyTarget: Set in Company Defaults as the daily gross profit target: the month's running costs spread over its weekdays. Weekends carry none.
titles.weekdaysElapsed: Monday-to-Friday days up to and including today. Public holidays still count.
titles.monthTarget: Daily target × every weekday in the month: the overhead the whole month must cover.
titles.achievement: Gross profit so far as a share of the whole month's target. Below 100% mid-month is normal.

labourDialog.title: Labour — {{month}}
labourDialog.description: Hours, cost and revenue from time entries

titles.totalHours: All paid hours recorded this month, including weekends and shop work. Unpaid time (lunch) and staff not set up in Xero Payroll are left out.
titles.billableHours: Hours marked billable on customer jobs. Time on the shop's own jobs never counts, even if marked billable.
titles.shopHours: Hours on the shop's own jobs: work done for the business, not for a customer, such as General work.
titles.labourRevenue: What customers are charged for billable hours this month.
titles.labourCost: Wages (including paid leave) for every paid hour this month, including shop and non-billable hours.
titles.labourProfit: Labour revenue less labour cost. Shop hours earn nothing but still cost wages, so they pull this down.
titles.averageRate: Labour revenue divided by billable hours: what a billed hour actually earned on average this month.
titles.utilisation: Billable hours as a share of all paid hours.
titles.labourMargin: Labour profit as a share of labour revenue.

titles.billedPerActiveDay: Billable hours divided by the days so far that had any hours recorded, so empty days don't drag the average down. Weekends worked count as days.
titles.materials: Profit on stock and purchases put on jobs this month: what customers are charged for them less what they cost us. Includes weekends even when they're hidden.
titles.adjustments: Profit from manual adjustment lines on jobs this month (revenue less cost).
titles.margin: Profit as a share of revenue for this stream. Shows a dash when there was no revenue.
titles.netProfit: Gross profit for the month so far, less overhead for the weekdays gone so far (daily gross profit target × weekdays elapsed). Only a true net profit while that target is set to the real overhead.
titles.netMargin: Net profit as a share of the month's total revenue.

titles.draftJobsCreated: Jobs created in this period, whatever their status now.
titles.quotesSubmitted: Times a job was moved to Awaiting approval in this period. A job sent back and resubmitted counts twice.
titles.jobsWon: Jobs created in this period that have since moved past draft and aren't marked rejected. Uses their status today, and includes jobs still awaiting quote approval.
titles.draftConversionRate: Jobs won as a share of jobs created in this period.
titles.quotesAccepted: Times a job was moved to Approved in this period.
titles.quoteAcceptanceRate: Quotes accepted as a share of quotes submitted in this period. Can top 100% when quotes sent earlier are accepted now.
titles.throughQuotesSkipped: First number: jobs sent for quote approval in this period. Second: jobs created in this period that have moved past draft without being sent for quote approval in this period.
titles.quoteUsage: Share of jobs that went through quote approval, out of both numbers above.

status.xero_only_departed: Left — Xero is still paying them
status.xero_only_unposted: Paid, but no hours were posted
status.xero_only_unknown: Paid, but DocketWorks has no record
status.xero_only_salaried: Salaried — hours are job allocation only

payrollPage.title: Payroll reconciliation — week of {{week}}
payrollPage.loadedNote: Wages including paid leave spread holiday, sick and other paid leave over the hours worked, while this week’s Xero gross does not — the difference column is not a reconciliation in this mode.
payrollPage.liveRunNote: Figures are read live from the week’s pay run. Xero recalculates a Draft’s pay for a couple of minutes after a post, so a difference seen immediately after posting may still be settling — re-check before acting on it.
payrollPage.noPayRunNote: Xero has no pay run for this week yet, so there is nothing to compare against. Any difference below is that absence, not a finding.
payrollPage.loading: Asking Xero what it computed for this week...
payrollPage.loadError: Could not read the payroll reconciliation.
payrollPage.empty: No staff and no pay slips for this week
payrollPage.baseTitle: Hours worked at each person’s base wage rate, with time and a half and double time applied. Paid leave is not spread over the hours.
payrollPage.loadedTitle: Base wages plus the labour cost loading from Company Defaults, which covers annual leave, public holidays, sick leave, bereavement leave and employer-paid ACC time.

columnTitles.xero: Gross pay Xero has worked out for this person for the week, before tax and deductions, read live from the week's pay run.
columnTitles.difference: Base wages in DocketWorks less Xero's gross. Positive means DocketWorks expects more than Xero will pay. Always uses base wages, even when the toggle shows wages including paid leave.
columnTitles.ourHours: Paid hours recorded in DocketWorks for this person, Monday to Sunday. Unpaid time (lunch) is left out.
columnTitles.xeroHours: Hours on Xero's pay slip, worked hours plus leave hours.

statusTitles.ok: Base wages are within 1% of Xero's gross (or within $1 on small amounts).
statusTitles.mismatch: Base wages and Xero's gross are more than 1% apart (or more than $1 on small amounts).
statusTitles.xero_only_departed: DocketWorks has them as left, but Xero is paying them this week. Run their final pay and terminate them in Xero.
statusTitles.xero_only_unposted: A current employee Xero is paying with no hours from DocketWorks; Xero pays their standard template hours. Either nobody entered their time, or their employment dates disagree.
statusTitles.xero_only_unknown: Xero has a pay slip for someone who matches no staff member in DocketWorks.
statusTitles.xero_only_salaried: Salaried: Xero pays a fixed salary, and their hours in DocketWorks only spread that cost across jobs, so the two aren't compared. Not a problem.
statusTitles.jm_only: DocketWorks has hours for this person but Xero has no pay slip for them this week.

payrollPage.unpostedCountTitle: People Xero is paying this week with no hours from DocketWorks: those who have left, current staff with no hours, and people DocketWorks doesn't know. Salaried staff not counted.
payrollPage.totalXeroTitle: Total gross pay on all of Xero's pay slips for this week.
